target_reason: Fixed geometry-based regions distinguish central response and the two load-transfer sides without assuming symmetry. Each region retains mean and signed depth-difference strain; no local peak or damage threshold is claimed.
sensor_reference: KYOWA KM-30-120-H1: 120 ohm, approximate GF 1.8, body 30x9x3 mm, approximate strain limit 0.2%. Uniform 30 mm strain transfer is an assumed observation kernel, not a manufacturer calibration.
lead_resistance_reason: Declared design scenario; actual lead length, resistance and temperature drift must be calibrated. Completion resistance matches the total reference string resistance.
excitation_gain_reason: 2.5 V excitation raises input common mode to 1.25 V. Gain 256 keeps the observed amplifier first-stage nodes and output inside the 5 V supply. A 1 V / gain-500 pilot had internal-headroom violations despite valid external output voltage.
load_reason: INA333 typical 100 Gohm differential/common-mode input impedance and 70 pA bias magnitude. Opposite signs are a declared mismatch scenario, not a measured device. ADG704 3 V supply maximum on resistance 8 ohm is used conservatively for a selected input path.
rf_deviation_reason: Leggiero MobiSys 2023 section 6.6; observed voltage deviations in its settings, not Gaussian noise or a guaranteed bound for this installation.

digital_alternative.conversion_time_source: ADS1220 SBAS501D section 8.3.7, Table 8-4: normal-mode single-shot cycles at 4.096 MHz; add up to 50 us for internal oscillator wake-up. External bridge/multiplexer settling and SPI/transport time are additional.
digital_alternative.interpretation: Datasheet feasibility alternative: direct bridge ADC plus digital backscatter, without the external INA. Noise values are typical shorted-input measurements at 3.3 V, internal 2.048 V reference, normal mode, PGA 128. They are not installed-system errors; ADC input loading, references, multiplexing, packet loss and power delivery still need implementation.

scan_reason: Energy bookkeeping scenario for six held structural-state samples plus reference slots. Not a demonstrated timing protocol; INA settling, cable capacitance and RF packet scheduling remain dependencies.
